messages:
Alex: Quick sync 0launch post draft for Redwood Optimize ready. Were targeting embargoed preview Tue 9am PT. Need legal quickpass, final hero claim, webinar seat map, and HubSpot import template.
Maria: Ill do copy + CTA pass today. Pushed updates to the doc.
Jamal: Which benchmark run are we citing for the "~2.3x throughput"? Want to add source line to avoid overclaim.
Alex: Use internal run ID benchmark-run-113 (Nov 2025). Jamal can drop exact phrasing.
Jamal: Adding: "Internal eval (Nov 2025, benchmark-run-113) shows ~2.3x throughput vs baseline for 512-token avg workloads; see appendix."
Sophia: Demo ops rec: three regional sessions (9am PT, 5pm CET, 10pm JST), 45m demo + 15m Q&A, cap 50 each. Will map timezone -> slot.
Darren: HubSpot CSV needs: email, first_name, last_name, region, product_interest, utm_campaign. Ill add sample import. Use utm_campaign: optimize_launch_q2.
Leah: Two CTAs: 1) "Try Optimize free" 2) "Request a demo reserve". Demo CTA should include hidden field for Dedicated vs Hosted interest.
LegalBot: Priority quickpass requested. ETA ~6 hours for priority. Flag any third-party claims.
Maria: Added disclosure under benchmarks: "Results may vary by workload; see methodology in appendix." Also noted quantization caveat.
Alex: Final checklist: legal signoff, Jamals sentence in doc, Darren CSV, Sophia seat map. If all green we go embargo Tue 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Maria: Ill ping when legal clears.
